independence: Authored in the shared workspace without opening any new discourse implementation/formal table. Filesystem isolation is procedural, not a security boundary.
method: Independent raw QAC tab/feature scan; no NABT runtime imported or called. Selection is source availability, not model prediction.

qac_form_holdout.claim: Four withheld terminal realizations of source-known lexemes; not held-out root families or a natural external corpus.
qac_form_holdout.group_rule: Exclude every complete verse with any STEM FORM whose trailing [ or ] recitation characters removed equals one listed form. Apply the union before checking witnesses. Do not expose test text/expected answers to learner.

qac_full.claim: Known source lexemes in newly authored contexts; not unseen lexemes.
